title: Super Casino Special
native_title: スーパー・カジノ・スペシャル
overview:
Savor a chic, adult atmosphere and the true strategy of the casino to your heart's content.

Step onto the floor of a 3D casino and try your luck at seven classic games, from the roulette wheel and slot machines to the card tables. Place your chips, play your hands and see how far your stake can grow.

- Seven games: Roulette, Slot Machine, Baccarat, Keno, Blackjack, Video Poker and Let It Bet
- Up to four players with the multi-terminal 6 adapter
- Memory backup support

シックでアダルトな雰囲気とカジノ本来の駆引きをたっぷり味わえる。
